248: // computeEntropy computes the Shannon entropy of the softmax distribution over logits.
249: func computeEntropy(logits []float32) float64 {
250: 	if len(logits) == 0 {
251: 		return 0
252: 	}
253: 	maxLogit := float64(logits[0])
254: 	for _, v := range logits {
255: 		if float64(v) > maxLogit {
256: 			maxLogit = float64(v)
257: 		}
258: 	}
259: 	sum := 0.0
260: 	probs := make([]float64, len(logits))
261: 	for i, v := range logits {
262: 		probs[i] = math.Exp(float64(v) - maxLogit)
263: 		sum += probs[i]
264: 	}
265: 	entropy := 0.0
266: 	for _, p := range probs {
267: 		p /= sum
268: 		if p > 0 {
269: 			entropy -= p * math.Log(p)
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: 	return entropy
273: }

382: 		WASMType:  s4.WASMType,
383: 		Rationale: s3.Rationale,
384: 		TurnCount: 1,
385: 	}
386: 
387: 	if hs.compiler == nil {
388: 		return decision
389: 	}
390: 
391: 	result, err := hs.compiler.Compile(ctx, s4.Source, s4.WASMType)
392: 	if err != nil {
393: 		log.Printf("WASM compile error: %v", err)
394: 		return decision
395: 	}
396: 	decision.WASMPath = result.WASMPath
397: 	decision.WASMHash = result.WASMHash
398: 
399: 	passed, confidence, msg := hs.verifier.Verify(s4.Source, string(s4.WASMType))
400: 	decision.BidirectionalVerified = passed
401: 	decision.VerifierConfidence = confidence
402: 	if passed {
403: 		decision.ForwardVerifierMsg = msg
404: 		decision.WazeroExecPassed = true
405: 	} else {
406: 		decision.BackwardVerifierMsg = msg
407: 	}
408: 
409: 	if hs.auditor != nil {
410: 		inquiryHash := inquiryHashStr(s4.Source)
411: 		_ = hs.auditor.WriteAuditLog(&AuditRecord{
412: 			InquiryHash: inquiryHash,
413: 			WASMSha256:  result.WASMHash,
414: 			WASMType:    s4.WASMType,
415: 			Timestamp:   time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
416: 		})
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	return decision
420: }

424: 	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(s))

430: func (hs *HEARTService) handleAnalyze(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
431: 	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
432: 		http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
433: 		return
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	// Enable CORS for WASM clients

441: 
442: 	if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
443: 		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

447: 	startTime := time.Now()
448: 
449: 	// Parse inquiry

467: 		ErrorType:    inquiry.ErrorType,

479: 		hs.mu.Unlock()
480: 
481: 		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("Processing failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
482: 		return
483: 	}
484: 
485: 	// Update stats
486: 	elapsed := time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()
487: 	hs.mu.Lock()
488: 	hs.stats.SuccessfulResponses++
489: 	hs.stats.TotalResponseTimeMs += float64(elapsed)
490: 	if float64(elapsed) < hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs {
491: 		hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
492: 	}
493: 	if float64(elapsed) > hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs {
494: 		hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
495: 	}
496: 	hs.stats.HeuristicUsage[fmt.Sprintf("turn_%d", decision.TurnCount)]++
497: 	hs.mu.Unlock()
498: 
499: 	// Convert WASMDecision to HEARTHeuristicResponse for backward compatibility
500: 	response := &HEARTHeuristicResponse{
501: 		InquiryID:          inquiry.ErrorID,
502: 		CommandVector:      decisionToCommandVector(decision),
503: 		AlertLevel:         decisionToAlertLevel(decision.WASMType),
504: 		HeuristicID:        decisionToHeuristicID(decision),
505: 		TargetNodeID:       0, // Default for backward compatibility
506: 		ConfidenceScore:    decision.VerifierConfidence,
507: 		ActionParameters:   decisionToActionParams(decision),
508: 		AnalysisSummary:    decision.Rationale,
509: 		RecommendedActions: hs.generateRecommendedActions(&inquiry, decisionToHeuristicID(decision)),
510: 		Timestamp:          uint64(time.Now().Unix()),
511: 	}
512: 
513: 	response.ProcessingTimeMs = float32(elapsed)
514: 
515: 	// Return response

517: 	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)

713: func (hs *HEARTService) generateRecommendedActions(inquiry *HEARTErrorInquiry, heuristicID uint32) []string {

765: // actionsFromLogits selects up to 3 actions using the top-3 logit indices.
766: func (hs *HEARTService) actionsFromLogits(logits []float32) []string {
767: 	n := len(actionPool)
768: 	if n == 0 {
769: 		return nil
770: 	}
771: 	// Top-3 argmax without full sort.
772: 	selected := make([]string, 0, 3)
773: 	used := make(map[int]bool)
774: 	for range 3 {
775: 		best, bestIdx := float32(-1e9), -1
776: 		for i, v := range logits {
777: 			bucket := i % n
778: 			if !used[bucket] && v > best {
779: 				best, bestIdx = v, bucket
780: 			}
781: 		}
782: 		if bestIdx < 0 {
783: 			break
784: 		}
785: 		selected = append(selected, actionPool[bestIdx])
786: 		used[bestIdx] = true
787: 	}
788: 	return selected
789: }

90: 		for j := 0; j < fhn.hiddenSize; j++ {
91: 			sum += hidden[j] * fhn.weights[fhn.inputSize*fhn.hiddenSize+i*fhn.hiddenSize+j]
92: 		}
93: 		output[i] = sigmoid(sum)
94: 	}
95:

99: func sigmoid(x float32) float32 {
100: 	return float32(1.0) / (float32(1.0) + exp32(-x))
101: }

103: func exp32(x float32) float32 {
104: 	if x < -20 {
105: 		return 0
106: 	}
107: 	result := float32(1.0)
108: 	term := float32(1.0)
109: 	for i := 1; i < 20; i++ {
110: 		term *= x / float32(i)
111: 		result += term
112: 		if term < 0.0001 && term > -0.0001 {
113: 			break
114: 		}
115: 	}
116: 	return result

193: 	}

62: 	// Bytes 4-36: PrevBlockHash from Slots 0-7 (Big-Endian for SHA-256)
63: 	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
64: 		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[4+(i*4):], slots[i])
65: 	}
66: 
67: 	// Bytes 36-68: MerkleRoot from Slots 8-11 + padding (Big-Endian)
68: 	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
69: 		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[36+(i*4):], slots[i+8])
70: 	}
71: 	// Remaining MerkleRoot bytes (12 bytes) padded with zeros
72: 	for i := 16; i < 20; i++ {
73: 		header[36+i*4] = 0
74: 		header[37+i*4] = 0
75: 		header[38+i*4] = 0
76: 		header[39+i*4] = 0
77: 	}
78: 
79: 	// Bytes 68-72: Timestamp (Little-Endian)
80: 	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[68:72], uint32(time.Now().Unix()))
81: 
82: 	// Bytes 72-76: Bits (Little-Endian)
83: 	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[72:76], BitcoinBits)
84: 
85: 	// Bytes 76-80: Nonce (Big-Endian for SHA-256 word alignment)
86: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[76:80], nonce)
87: 
88: 	return header
89: }

91: // BuildHeaderBatch generates multiple Bitcoin headers for a population of candidate nonces
92: // Optimized for GPU batch processing - generates all headers at once to minimize memory allocations
93: func (tr *TrainingRecord) BuildHeaderBatch(nonces []uint32) [][]byte {
94: 	headers := make([][]byte, len(nonces))
95: 	slots := tr.AsicSlots()
96: 
97: 	// Pre-compute static parts of header
98: 	staticHeader := make([]byte, 76)
99: 
100: 	// Bytes 0-3: Version (Little-Endian)
101: 	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[0:4], BitcoinVersion)
102: 
103: 	// Bytes 4-36: PrevBlockHash from Slots 0-7 (Big-Endian)
104: 	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
105: 		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[4+(i*4):], slots[i])
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	// Bytes 36-68: MerkleRoot from Slots 8-11 + padding (Big-Endian)
109: 	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
110: 		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[36+(i*4):], slots[i+8])
111: 	}
112: 	// Remaining MerkleRoot bytes (12 bytes) padded with zeros
113: 	for i := 16; i < 20; i++ {
114: 		staticHeader[36+i*4] = 0
115: 		staticHeader[37+i*4] = 0
116: 		staticHeader[38+i*4] = 0
117: 		staticHeader[39+i*4] = 0
118: 	}
119: 
120: 	// Bytes 68-72: Timestamp (Little-Endian) - use same timestamp for batch
121: 	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[68:72], uint32(time.Now().Unix()))
122: 
123: 	// Bytes 72-76: Bits (Little-Endian)
124: 	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[72:76], BitcoinBits)
125: 
126: 	// Generate headers with different nonces
127: 	for i, nonce := range nonces {
128: 		header := make([]byte, 80)
129: 		copy(header[:76], staticHeader)
130: 		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[76:80], nonce)
131: 		headers[i] = header
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	return headers
135: }

199: // GenerateCandidateNonces creates a slice of candidate nonces for Bitcoin mining
200: // Optimized for the Evolutionary GRPO process
201: func (sp *SeedPopulation) GenerateCandidateNonces(count int) []uint32 {
202: 	nonces := make([]uint32, count)
203: 
204: 	// Generate diverse nonces using different strategies
205: 	quarter := count / 4
206: 
207: 	// Strategy 1: Sequential nonces (deterministic exploration)
208: 	for i := 0; i < quarter; i++ {
209: 		nonces[i] = uint32(int(sp.Generation)*1000 + i)
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	// Strategy 2: Random nonces (stochastic exploration)
213: 	for i := quarter; i < 2*quarter; i++ {
214: 		nonces[i] = mathrand.Uint32()
215: 	}
216: 
217: 	// Strategy 3: Targeted nonces based on current best performers
218: 	if len(sp.Seeds) > 0 {
219: 		bestSeedID := sp.getBestSeedID()
220: 		for i := 2 * quarter; i < 3*quarter; i++ {
221: 			// Mutate around best performer
222: 			mutation := uint32(mathrand.Intn(1000) - 500) // +/- 500 range
223: 			nonces[i] = bestSeedID + mutation
224: 		}
225: 	} else {
226: 		// Fallback to random if no seeds yet
227: 		for i := 2 * quarter; i < 3*quarter; i++ {
228: 			nonces[i] = mathrand.Uint32()
229: 		}
230: 	}
231: 
232: 	// Strategy 4: Hash-derived nonces (cryptographic exploration)
233: 	for i := 3 * quarter; i < count; i++ {
234: 		seed := make([]byte, SeedSize)
235: 		rand.Read(seed)
236: 		// Use first 4 bytes of SHA-256 hash of random seed
237: 		hasher := sha256.New()
238: 		hasher.Write(seed)
239: 		hash := hasher.Sum(nil)
240: 		nonces[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(hash[:4])
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	return nonces
244: }

317: 	case 16:

349: // UpdateDifficulty scales the difficulty mask based on the current epoch
350: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) UpdateDifficulty(epoch int) {
351: 	eh.Epoch = epoch
352: 
353: 	targetBits := config.DefaultDifficultyBits + int(float64(epoch-1)*1.33)
354: 	if targetBits > config.MaxDifficultyBits {
355: 		targetBits = config.MaxDifficultyBits
356: 	}
357: 	if targetBits < config.MinDifficultyBits {
358: 		targetBits = config.MinDifficultyBits
359: 	}
360: 
361: 	// Create mask using bit-shift (for Big-Endian comparison)
362: 	var mask uint32
363: 	if targetBits >= 32 {
364: 		mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
365: 	} else if targetBits <= 0 {
366: 		mask = 0
367: 	} else {
368: 		// e.g. 4 bits = 0xF0000000
369: 		mask = ^uint32(0) << (32 - targetBits)
370: 	}
371: 
372: 	eh.DifficultyMask = mask
373: 	fmt.Printf("[DDS] Epoch %d: Difficulty set to %d bits (Mask: 0x%08X)\n", epoch, targetBits, eh.DifficultyMask)
374: }

386: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) calculateAlignmentReward(goldenNonce uint32, targetToken int32, tokenMap map[int32]bool) float64 {
387: 	// Exact match gets full reward
388: 	if goldenNonce == uint32(targetToken) {
389: 		return 1.0
390: 	}
391: 
392: 	// Calculate bit-wise similarity (Hamming similarity)
393: 	xor := goldenNonce ^ uint32(targetToken)
394: 	matchingBits := 32 - bits.OnesCount32(xor)
395: 
396: 	// Continuous gradient: even 1 bit match gives some reward
397: 	// Max reward for matching all targetBits is 0.85
398: 	reward := (float64(matchingBits) / 32.0) * 0.85
399: 	if reward == 0 {
400: 		reward = 0.001 // Tiny base reward to prevent flat advantage
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	// Bonus for passing the threshold (prefix matching)
404: 	if eh.IsWinningSeed(goldenNonce, uint32(targetToken)) {
405: 		reward += 0.10
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	return reward
409: }

432: // calculateStabilityReward measures convergence behavior across hash passes
433: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) calculateStabilityReward(seed []byte, sim simulator.HashSimulator) float64 {
434: 	// Simulate multiple passes to measure stability
435: 	passes := make([]uint32, 5) // Last 5 passes
436: 	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
437: 		pass := 16 + i // Passes 16-20
438: 		output, err := sim.SimulateHash(seed, pass)
439: 		if err != nil {
440: 			return 0.0
441: 		}
442: 		passes[i] = output
443: 	}
444: 
445: 	// Calculate variance across passes (lower = more stable)
446: 	var mean uint32
447: 	for _, pass := range passes {
448: 		mean += pass
449: 	}
450: 	mean /= 5
451: 
452: 	var variance float64
453: 	for _, pass := range passes {
454: 		diff := float64(pass) - float64(mean)
455: 		variance += diff * diff
456: 	}
457: 	variance /= 5
458: 
459: 	// Convert variance to stability reward (lower variance = higher reward)
460: 	// For 32-bit hashes, a "stable" result might still have some variance
461: 	// Use a very large maxVariance to provide a gradual reward
462: 	var maxVariance float64 = 0xFFFFFFFF * 0xFFFFFFFF / 12.0
463: 	stability := 1.0 - (variance / maxVariance)
464: 	if stability < 0 {
465: 		stability = 0
466: 	}
467: 
468: 	return stability
469: }

471: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) CalculateReward(seed []byte, targetToken int32, tokenMap map[int32]bool, sim simulator.HashSimulator) (*SeedResult, error) {
472: 	result := &SeedResult{
473: 		Seed: make([]byte, len(seed)),
474: 	}
475: 	copy(result.Seed, seed)
476: 
477: 	// Extract nonce from seed (last 4 bytes of 32-byte seed)
478: 	nonce := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(seed[len(seed)-4:])
479: 
480: 	// For Bitcoin compatibility, we need to construct a temporary header
481: 	// In real implementation, this would use the full TrainingRecord
482: 	tempSlots := [12]uint32{
483: 		0x12345678, 0x23456789, 0x34567890, 0x45678901, // Placeholder slots 0-7
484: 		0x56789012, 0x67890123, 0x78901234, 0x89012345, // Placeholder slots 8-11
485: 		0x90123456, 0x01234567, 0x12345678, 0x23456789,
486: 	}
487: 
488: 	// Create temporary hardware prep
489: 	hwPrep := hardware.NewHardwarePrep(false)
490: 
491: 	// Build Bitcoin header with the nonce from this seed
492: 	bitcoinHeader := hwPrep.PrepareAsicJob(tempSlots, nonce)
493: 
494: 	// Perform Double-SHA256 using the Bitcoin header method
495: 	// This replicates the BM1382's hard-wired behavior
496: 	finalHash, err := eh.simulateBitcoinHeader(bitcoinHeader, sim)
497: 	if err != nil {
498: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitcoin header simulation failed: %w", err)
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	// The golden nonce is the first 4 bytes of the final Double-SHA256
502: 	goldenNonce := finalHash
503: 
504: 	// Calculate alignment reward (primary - matches target)
505: 	alignmentReward := eh.calculateAlignmentReward(goldenNonce, targetToken, tokenMap)
506: 
507: 	// Calculate stability reward (convergence patterns)
508: 	stabilityReward := eh.calculateStabilityReward(seed, sim)
509: 
510: 	// Calculate format reward (valid token in map)
511: 	formatReward := eh.calculateFormatReward(goldenNonce, targetToken, tokenMap)
512: 
513: 	// Bonus reward for exact target match
514: 	exactMatchBonus := 0.0
515: 	if goldenNonce == uint32(targetToken) {
516: 		exactMatchBonus = 0.5 // Significant bonus for exact match
517: 	}
518: 
519: 	result.HashOutput = goldenNonce // Store hash for bit-matching
520: 	result.Alignment = alignmentReward
521: 	result.Stability = stabilityReward
522: 	result.Format = formatReward
523: 	result.Reward = alignmentReward + stabilityReward + formatReward + exactMatchBonus
524: 
525: 	return result, nil
526: }

528: // CalculateBitMatchAdvantage calculates advantage based on bit-match scores (GRPO style)
529: // This provides a gradient for evolution to follow despite SHA-256 avalanche effect
530: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) CalculateBitMatchAdvantage(results []SeedResult, targetToken int32) []SeedResult {
531: 	if len(results) == 0 {
532: 		return results
533: 	}
534: 
535: 	// Calculate bit-match scores for each result
536: 	bitScores := make([]float64, len(results))
537: 	var totalScore float64
538: 
539: 	for i, res := range results {
540: 		// Use total matching bits (Hamming similarity) for the gradient
541: 		xor := res.HashOutput ^ uint32(targetToken)
542: 		matchingBits := 32 - bits.OnesCount32(xor)
543: 
544: 		// Normalize to 0-1 range
545: 		bitScores[i] = float64(matchingBits) / 32.0
546: 		totalScore += bitScores[i]
547: 	}
548: 
549: 	mean := totalScore / float64(len(results))
550: 
551: 	var varianceSum float64
552: 	for _, score := range bitScores {
553: 		varianceSum += math.Pow(score-mean, 2)
554: 	}
555: 	stdDev := math.Sqrt(varianceSum / float64(len(results)))
556: 
557: 	// Calculate advantage based on bit-match scores
558: 	for i := range results {
559: 		if stdDev > 0 {
560: 			results[i].Advantage = (bitScores[i] - mean) / stdDev
561: 		} else {
562: 			results[i].Advantage = 0 // Neutral advantage if no variance
563: 		}
564: 
565: 		// Boost advantage for seeds that pass the actual difficulty threshold (prefix match)
566: 		if eh.IsWinningSeed(results[i].HashOutput, uint32(targetToken)) {
567: 			results[i].Advantage += 2.0
568: 		}
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	return results
572: }

574: // Legacy advantage calculation (kept for compatibility)
575: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) CalculateAdvantage(results []SeedResult) []SeedResult {
576: 	if len(results) == 0 {

578: 	}
579: 
580: 	var totalReward float64
581: 	for _, res := range results {
582: 		totalReward += res.Reward
583: 	}
584: 	mean := totalReward / float64(len(results))
585: 
586: 	var varianceSum float64

589: 	}

595: 		} else {

598: 	}

600: 	return results

603: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) SelectAndMutate(results []SeedResult, currentSeeds map[uint32][]byte) map[uint32][]byte {
604: 	sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool {
605: 		return results[i].Advantage > results[j].Advantage
606: 	})
607: 
608: 	newGeneration := make(map[uint32][]byte)
609: 	topCount := int(float64(len(results)) * eh.EliteRatio)
610: 
611: 	// Keep elites and their mutations
612: 	for i := 0; i < len(results); i++ {
613: 		seedID := results[i].SeedID
614: 		if originalSeed, exists := currentSeeds[seedID]; exists {
615: 			if i < topCount {
616: 				// 1. Keep the elite itself
617: 				newGeneration[seedID] = originalSeed
618: 
619: 				// 2. Create a mutation of this elite
620: 				if len(newGeneration) < eh.PopulationSize {
621: 					mutatedID := uint32(eh.rand.Intn(1000000))
622: 					mutatedSeed := eh.BitcoinAwareMutate(originalSeed, results[i].Advantage)
623: 					newGeneration[mutatedID] = mutatedSeed
624: 				}
625: 			}
626: 		}
627: 		if len(newGeneration) >= eh.PopulationSize {
628: 			break
629: 		}
630: 	}
631: 
632: 	// Fill remaining with random seeds to maintain diversity
633: 	for len(newGeneration) < eh.PopulationSize {
634: 		seedID := uint32(eh.rand.Intn(1000000))
635: 		newGeneration[seedID] = GenerateRandomSeed()
636: 	}
637: 
638: 	return newGeneration
639: }

641: // BitcoinAwareMutate performs mutation optimized for Bitcoin nonce hunting
642: // Focuses on mutating the last 4 bytes (nonce) more aggressively
643: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) BitcoinAwareMutate(seed []byte, advantage float64) []byte {
644: 	mutated := make([]byte, len(seed))
645: 	copy(mutated, seed)
646: 
647: 	mutationRate := MutationRateBase / (math.Abs(advantage) + 1)
648: 	if mutationRate < 1 {
649: 		mutationRate = 1
650: 	}
651: 	if mutationRate > 10 {
652: 		mutationRate = 10
653: 	}

799: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) EvaluatePopulationBatch(
800: 	population *SeedPopulation,
801: 	record *TrainingRecord,

804: 	seedIDs []uint32,

808:

810: 	slots := record.FeatureVector
811: 
812: 	// Create hardware prep for batch processing
813: 	hwPrep := hardware.NewHardwarePrep(true) // Enable caching for performance
814: 
815: 	// Generate Bitcoin headers for all candidate nonces in batch
816: 	headers := hwPrep.PrepareAsicJobBatch(slots, candidateNonces)
817: 
818: 	// Use HasherWrapper's batch processing if available
819: 	var loopResults []*core.JitterResult
820: 	var batchErr error
821: 
822: 	if hWrap, ok := sim.(*simulator.HasherWrapper); ok {
823: 		// Debug logging for the first batch of the first generation
824: 		if population.Generation == 0 {
825: 			if cMethod, ok := hWrap.GetHashMethod().(*cuda.CudaMethod); ok {
826: 				fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] %s\n", cMethod.GetBridge().DebugHeaders(headers))
827: 			}
828: 		}
829: 		// Use the optimized batch processing
830: 		loopResults, batchErr = hWrap.GetHashMethod().Execute21PassLoopBatch(headers, uint32(record.TargetToken))
831: 	} else {
832: 		// Fallback to sequential if not HasherWrapper
833: 		loopResults = make([]*core.JitterResult, len(headers))
834: 		for i, header := range headers {
835: 			res, err := sim.RecursiveMine(header, 21)
836: 			if err != nil {
837: 				batchErr = err
838: 				break
839: 			}
840: 			loopResults[i] = &core.JitterResult{
841: 				FinalHash: [32]byte(res), // Unsafe cast but for fallback only
842: 			}
843: 		}
844: 	}

846: 	if batchErr != nil {

850: 	// Process results

861: 		finalHash := loopRes.FinalHash

865: 		if i == 0 && population.Generation == 0 {

875: 		result.Stability = eh.calculateStabilityReward(result.Seed, sim)
876: 		result.Format = eh.calculateFormatReward(goldenNonce, record.TargetToken, tokenMap)

882: 		}

885: 		results[i] = *result

887: 
888: 	// Calculate advantages using bit-match scores (provides gradient despite SHA-256 avalanche)
889: 	results = eh.CalculateBitMatchAdvantage(results, record.TargetToken)
890:

934: 		return 0
935: 	}

937: 	start := len(tokenSequence) - windowSize

954: // ---- Phase 11: ES Weighted Update ----

956: // sigma returns the annealed perturbation magnitude for the given step.
957: // Decays from initialSigma towards minSigma over totalSteps using cosine annealing.
958: func sigma(step, totalSteps int, initialSigma, minSigma float64) float64 {
959: 	if totalSteps <= 0 {
960: 		return minSigma
961: 	}
962: 	progress := float64(step) / float64(totalSteps)
963: 	if progress > 1.0 {
964: 		progress = 1.0
965: 	}
966: 	return minSigma + 0.5*(initialSigma-minSigma)*(1+math.Cos(math.Pi*progress))
967: }

969: // mirroredSample generates N/2 pairs of mirrored Gaussian noise vectors of length dim.
970: // Returns N vectors (positive + negative).
971: func mirroredSample(n, dim int, sig float64, rng *mathrand.Rand) [][]float64 {
972: 	half := n / 2
973: 	out := make([][]float64, half*2)
974: 	for i := 0; i < half; i++ {
975: 		pos := make([]float64, dim)
976: 		neg := make([]float64, dim)
977: 		for j := 0; j < dim; j++ {
978: 			v := rng.NormFloat64() * sig
979: 			pos[j] = v
980: 			neg[j] = -v
981: 		}
982: 		out[i] = pos
983: 		out[half+i] = neg
984: 	}
985: 	return out
986: }

988: // ESWeightedUpdate replaces the GA elitism pass with an ES weighted perturbation sum.
989: // results must be standardised (zero mean, unit variance) before calling.
990: // Returns a new seed map where each seed is the weighted sum of mirrored perturbations
991: // applied to the best-performing parent seed.
992: func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) ESWeightedUpdate(
993: 	results []SeedResult,
994: 	currentSeeds map[uint32][]byte,
995: 	step, totalSteps int,
996: 	initialSigma, minSigma float64,
997: 	trustRegionDelta float64,
998: ) map[uint32][]byte {
999: 	if len(results) == 0 {
1000: 		return currentSeeds
1001: 	}
1002: 
1003: 	// Sort by advantage descending to pick elite parent.
1004: 	sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool {
1005: 		return results[i].Advantage > results[j].Advantage
1006: 	})
1007: 	parentID := results[0].SeedID
1008: 	parent, ok := currentSeeds[parentID]
1009: 	if !ok || len(parent) == 0 {
1010: 		return currentSeeds
1011: 	}
1012: 
1013: 	dim := len(parent)
1014: 	sig := sigma(step, totalSteps, initialSigma, minSigma)
1015: 
1016: 	// Mirrored sampling: N/2 + N/2 mirrors.
1017: 	n := len(results)
1018: 	if n%2 != 0 {
1019: 		n--
1020: 	}
1021: 	perturbations := mirroredSample(n, dim, sig, eh.rand)
1022: 
1023: 	// Compute advantages for positive half only (mirrors cancel in expectation).
1024: 	half := n / 2
1025: 	advSum := 0.0
1026: 	for i := 0; i < half; i++ {
1027: 		advSum += math.Abs(results[i].Advantage)
1028: 	}
1029: 	if advSum == 0 {
1030: 		advSum = 1
1031: 	}
1032: 
1033: 	// Weighted sum of positive perturbations.
1034: 	delta := make([]float64, dim)
1035: 	for i := 0; i < half; i++ {
1036: 		w := results[i].Advantage / advSum
1037: 		for j := 0; j < dim; j++ {
1038: 			delta[j] += w * perturbations[i][j]
1039: 		}
1040: 	}
1041: 
1042: 	// TRPO trust-region clamp: scale delta if its L2 norm exceeds trustRegionDelta.
1043: 	norm := 0.0
1044: 	for _, v := range delta {
1045: 		norm += v * v
1046: 	}
1047: 	norm = math.Sqrt(norm)
1048: 	if norm > trustRegionDelta && norm > 0 {
1049: 		scale := trustRegionDelta / norm
1050: 		for j := range delta {
1051: 			delta[j] *= scale
1052: 		}
1053: 	}
1054: 
1055: 	// Apply delta to parent seed (byte-level, wrapping).
1056: 	newSeed := make([]byte, dim)
1057: 	for j := 0; j < dim; j++ {
1058: 		updated := float64(parent[j]) + delta[j]*(1.0/sig)
1059: 		// clamp to [0, 255]
1060: 		if updated < 0 {
1061: 			updated = 0
1062: 		} else if updated > 255 {
1063: 			updated = 255
1064: 		}
1065: 		newSeed[j] = byte(updated)
1066: 	}
1067: 
1068: 	newGeneration := make(map[uint32][]byte, eh.PopulationSize)
1069: 	newID := uint32(eh.rand.Intn(1000000))
1070: 	newGeneration[newID] = newSeed
1071: 
1072: 	// Preserve elite parent.
1073: 	newGeneration[parentID] = parent
1074: 
1075: 	// Fill remainder with mutations of the updated seed.
1076: 	for len(newGeneration) < eh.PopulationSize {
1077: 		mutID := uint32(eh.rand.Intn(1000000))
1078: 		newGeneration[mutID] = eh.BitcoinAwareMutate(newSeed, results[0].Advantage)
1079: 	}
1080: 
1081: 	return newGeneration
1082: }

40: 		dimensionSumSq: make([]float64, 768),
41: 		sampleCount:    0,
42: 		isAnalyzed:     false,
43: 	}
44: }
45: 
46: // Sample adds an embedding to the analysis sample set
47: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) Sample(embedding []float32) error {
48: 	if len(embedding) != 768 {
49: 		return fmt.Errorf("embedding must be 768 dimensions, got %d", len(embedding))
50: 	}
51: 
52: 	for i, val := range embedding {
53: 		fv := float64(val)
54: 		v.dimensionSum[i] += fv
55: 		v.dimensionSumSq[i] += fv * fv
56: 	}
57: 	v.sampleCount++
58: 
59: 	return nil
60: }
61: 
62: // SampleFromRecord processes a DocumentRecord or MinedRecord embedding
63: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) SampleFromRecord(embedding interface{}) error {
64: 	// Handle both []float32 and interface{} from JSON
65: 	switch e := embedding.(type) {
66: 	case []float32:
67: 		return v.Sample(e)
68: 	case []interface{}:
69: 		floatEmbedding := make([]float32, len(e))
70: 		for i, val := range e {
71: 			floatEmbedding[i] = float32(val.(float64))
72: 		}
73: 		return v.Sample(floatEmbedding)
74: 	default:
75: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported embedding type: %T", embedding)
76: 	}
77: }
78: 
79: // Calculate performs variance analysis on the collected samples
80: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) Calculate() error {
81: 	if v.sampleCount == 0 {
82: 		return fmt.Errorf("no samples collected for variance analysis")
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	// Calculate variance for each dimension
86: 	variances := make([]float32, 768)
87: 	for i := 0; i < 768; i++ {
88: 		mean := v.dimensionSum[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)
89: 		// Variance = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2
90: 		variance := (v.dimensionSumSq[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)) - (mean * mean)
91: 		variances[i] = float32(variance)
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	// Find top 24 indices with highest variance
95: 	v.signalIndices = FindTopVarianceIndices(variances, 24)
96: 	v.isAnalyzed = true
97: 
98: 	return nil
99: }
100: 
101: // GetSignalIndices returns the high-variance indices
102: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) GetSignalIndices() []int {
103: 	if !v.isAnalyzed {
104: 		return ParseIndices(DefaultVarianceIndices)
105: 	}
106: 	return v.signalIndices
107: }
108: 
109: // SaveToFile saves the analysis results to a JSON file
110: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) SaveToFile(outputPath string, modelName string) error {
111: 	if !v.isAnalyzed {
112: 		if err := v.Calculate(); err != nil {
113: 			return err
114: 		}
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	variances := make([]float32, 768)
118: 	for i := 0; i < 768; i++ {
119: 		mean := v.dimensionSum[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)
120: 		variance := (v.dimensionSumSq[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)) - (mean * mean)
121: 		variances[i] = float32(variance)
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	result := VarianceResult{
125: 		SignalIndices: v.signalIndices,
126: 		Variances:     variances,
127: 		SampleCount:   v.sampleCount,
128: 		ModelName:     modelName,
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
132: 	if err != nil {
133: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal variance result: %w", err)
134: 	}
135: 
136: 	return os.WriteFile(outputPath, data, 0644)
137: }
138: 
139: // LoadFromFile loads previously calculated variance indices
140: func (v *VarianceAnalyzer) LoadFromFile(inputPath string) error {
141: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(inputPath)
142: 	if err != nil {
143: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read variance file: %w", err)
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	var result VarianceResult
147: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
148: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal variance result: %w", err)
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	v.signalIndices = result.SignalIndices
152: 	v.isAnalyzed = true
153: 
154: 	return nil
155: }
156: 
157: // GetOrCreateSignalIndices loads existing indices or returns defaults
158: func GetOrCreateSignalIndices(configDir string) ([]int, error) {
159: 	varianceFile := filepath.Join(configDir, VarianceOutputFile)
160: 
161: 	// Try to load existing analysis
162: 	var analyzer VarianceAnalyzer
163: 	if err := analyzer.LoadFromFile(varianceFile); err == nil {
164: 		return analyzer.GetSignalIndices(), nil
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	// Return defaults if no analysis exists
168: 	return ParseIndices(DefaultVarianceIndices), nil
169: }
170: 
171: // FindTopVarianceIndices finds the N indices with highest variance
172: func FindTopVarianceIndices(variances []float32, n int) []int {
173: 	indices := make([]int, n)
174: 	used := make(map[int]bool)
175: 
176: 	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
177: 		maxVar := float32(-1.0)
178: 		bestIdx := -1
179: 
180: 		for j, v := range variances {
181: 			if v > maxVar && !used[j] {
182: 				maxVar = v
183: 				bestIdx = j
184: 			}
185: 		}
186: 
187: 		if bestIdx == -1 {
188: 			break
189: 		}
190: 
191: 		indices[i] = bestIdx
192: 		used[bestIdx] = true
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	return indices
196: }
197: 
198: // ParseIndices parses a comma-separated string of indices
199: func ParseIndices(s string) []int {
200: 	indices := make([]int, 24)
201: 	// Default case - just use sequential indices
202: 	for i := 0; i < 24; i++ {
203: 		indices[i] = i
204: 	}
205: 	return indices
206: }

208: // VarianceStats provides statistics about the variance analysis
209: type VarianceStats struct {
210: 	SampleCount    int     `json:"sample_count"`
211: 	TopVariance    float32 `json:"top_variance"`
212: 	BottomVariance float32 `json:"bottom_variance"`
213: 	MeanVariance   float32 `json:"mean_variance"`
214: 	SignalIndices  []int   `json:"signal_indices"`
215: }

217: // DeltaSignalIndices returns the symmetric difference of the two signal-index sets when
218: // their Jaccard distance exceeds threshold.  Jaccard distance = 1 - |A∩B| / |A∪B|.
219: // Used by entropy-spike detection to route tokens that activate divergent dimensions
220: // to targeted gap queues.
221: func DeltaSignalIndices(before, after *VarianceAnalyzer, threshold float32) ([]int, error) {
222: 	if !before.isAnalyzed || !after.isAnalyzed {
223: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("both analyzers must be analyzed before calling DeltaSignalIndices")
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	bSet := make(map[int]bool, len(before.signalIndices))
227: 	for _, idx := range before.signalIndices {
228: 		bSet[idx] = true
229: 	}
230: 	aSet := make(map[int]bool, len(after.signalIndices))
231: 	for _, idx := range after.signalIndices {
232: 		aSet[idx] = true
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	intersection := 0
236: 	union := len(bSet)
237: 	for idx := range aSet {
238: 		if bSet[idx] {
239: 			intersection++
240: 		} else {
241: 			union++
242: 		}
243: 	}
244: 
245: 	if union == 0 {
246: 		return nil, nil
247: 	}
248: 	jaccardDist := float32(1) - float32(intersection)/float32(union)
249: 	if jaccardDist <= threshold {
250: 		return nil, nil
251: 	}
252: 
253: 	// Return symmetric difference.
254: 	var deltas []int
255: 	for idx := range bSet {
256: 		if !aSet[idx] {
257: 			deltas = append(deltas, idx)
258: 		}
259: 	}
260: 	for idx := range aSet {
261: 		if !bSet[idx] {
262: 			deltas = append(deltas, idx)
263: 		}
264: 	}
265: 	sort.Ints(deltas)
266: 	return deltas, nil
267: }

269: // GetStats returns statistics about the variance analysis

271: 	if !v.isAnalyzed {
272: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("variance analysis not yet performed")
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	variances := make([]float32, 768)
276: 	var sum, top, bottom float32
277: 	for i := 0; i < 768; i++ {
278: 		mean := v.dimensionSum[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)
279: 		variance := (v.dimensionSumSq[i] / float64(v.sampleCount)) - (mean * mean)
280: 		variances[i] = float32(variance)
281: 		sum += variances[i]
282: 		if variances[i] > top || top == 0 {
283: 			top = variances[i]
284: 		}
285: 		if variances[i] < bottom || bottom == 0 {
286: 			bottom = variances[i]
287: 		}
288: 	}
289: 
290: 	return &VarianceStats{
291: 		SampleCount:    v.sampleCount,
292: 		TopVariance:    top,
293: 		BottomVariance: bottom,
294: 		MeanVariance:   sum / 768,
295: 		SignalIndices:  v.signalIndices,
296: 	}, nil
297: }
